items.prompt: Why does the value<target branch setlo=mid+1 rather thanlo=mid?

options.text: Because mid is always the final equal-value answer
options.why: This branch has established value[mid] is too small.

options.text: Because empty input requires a negative index
options.why: The algorithm starts with an empty half-open region for empty input.

options.text: To discard the known-too-small mid and guarantee progress
options.why: Keeping mid can leave a one-element interval unchanged.

options.text: To skip all input validation permanently

items.explanation: Discard positions that cannot be the lower bound, and prove the unresolved interval decreases at every iteration.
